|lore=Cybot Galactica 3PO human-cyborg relations droid. Fluent in over six million forms of communication. 112 years old. Has never been memorywiped... as far as he knows.
|game_text=Once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to activate 1 Force (or to ▲ [A New Hope] R2-D2). During your control phase, if with a Rebel at an interior mobile battleground, opponent loses 1 Force.
